description: Edits one Notion page's content as markdown, in one of three modes. edits replaces exact passages, each {old_str, new_str, replace_all_matches}; an edit whose old_str matches nothing is listed in warnings while the others apply. replace_with replaces the whole content. insert adds markdown at the start, at the end (the default), or after a selection. Child pages and databases are kept unless allow_deleting_content is true, and Notion refuses an edit that would remove them. The content of a synced page is not edited through Notion's API. Returns the page id and Notion's warnings.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

after.description: With insert: a selection of existing content to insert after, written "start text...end text".

allow_async.description: true lets Notion apply a large change in the background; the result is then a task id and carries no warnings.

allow_deleting_content.description: With edits or replace_with: true lets the change remove child pages and databases. Sent to Notion only when set.

edits.description: Passage replacements, at most 100, applied in one request. notion_get_page shows the markdown they match against.

new_str.description: The text that replaces old_str. Empty deletes the passage.

old_str.description: Text in the page's markdown, matched exactly. Not empty.

replace_all_matches.description: true replaces every match. Default false, where an old_str with several matches is refused by Notion.

insert.description: Markdown to add to the page, placed by position or after.

page_id.description: The page's Notion id, with or without dashes, or a Notion URL that contains it (the id is read from the URL).

position.description: With insert: start or end of the page. Default end.

replace_with.description: Markdown that replaces the page's whole content.

name: notion-mcp__notion_update_page_content
